name: Rise or Fall
source:
You take control of Jessy who, after an incident, now has to serve a probation sentence and will also have other troubles. Will you gain strength and influence from the challenges that lie ahead or will you perish?

[From [url=You take control of Jessy who, after an incident, now has to serve a probation sentence and will also have other troubles. Will you gain strength and influence from the challenges that lie ahead or will you perish?]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你將操控傑西。一樁變故過後，傑西被判緩刑，除此之外還有別的麻煩找上門來。面對接踵而來的考驗，你會從中獲得力量和影響力，還是會就此喪命？
